column2: Students and Parents register for their FSA ID and Password & 2025-2026 FAFSA opens by December 31st.Both students and parents will need to sign up for their FSA ID and Password on studentaid.gov if they have never created an account. These accounts can take a few days to be verified, so don’t delay in setting them up!
Complete the 2025-2026 FAFSAOnce the 2025-2026 FAFSA is open, complete the FAFSA as soon as possible for the best opportunities for federal and state aid.
The initial financial aid offer letters was mailed to students and all updates are available within the Bearcat Portal.
